pageTitle: Battle of Imagined Arrays/Companion Caper Chronicles
name: Chroniques des compagnons de castagne
description: You have no recollection of how you arrived here, awakening amidst tangling vines and surrounded by dense forest that blocks out the sky. You don't know who you are, where you came from, or where you were going... but none of that matters. All you know is that you must seek out companions and pass the many obstacles that await as you attempt to leave this jungle...
